evidence.ACL: chronic complete tear with ligamentous resorption of the anterior cruciate ligament
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: complex tear (main horizontal and radial components) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: longitudinal vertical tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: focal grade II chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posteromedial tibial plateau and corresponding posterior weight-baring medial femoral condyle
evidence.Lateral OA: focal grade II chondral injury at mid weight-baring lateral femoral condyle and posterolateral tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
